risk_description: Offline synchronization conflict resolution using 'Last-Write-Wins' strategy may lead to unintentional user data loss in complex editing scenarios involving multiple devices.
root_cause: The architectural decision to use a simplified 'Last-Write-Wins' strategy for the Offline Mutation Queue does not account for granular field-level merges or semantic intent.
mitigation_strategy: Implement vector clock versioning or a detailed change-log pattern instead of simple timestamps. Introduce a 'Conflict Resolution' UI flow in Flutter to allow users to manually resolve specific data collisions.
contingency_plan: Fallback to a 'Server-Authority' model where local changes are discarded upon conflict, with a user notification to reload data.
monitoring_trigger: Sync error rate > 1% or 'Data Overwritten' user support tickets exceeding 3 per week.

risk_description: OpenAI GPT-4 API latency will almost certainly exceed the project's 95th percentile latency requirement of < 200ms for recommendation endpoints.
root_cause: LLM inference time is inherently variable and typically ranges from 1-5 seconds, conflicting directly with the strict 200ms NFR for the recommendation orchestrator.
mitigation_strategy: Decouple the recommendation generation from the user request. Pre-compute recommendations asynchronously via Hangfire jobs and store results in a Redis cache for sub-20ms retrieval.
contingency_plan: Implement a 'Loading/Processing' UI state in the mobile app to mask latency, or switch to a faster, less capable model (e.g., GPT-3.5-Turbo) if latency is paramount.
monitoring_trigger: Average response time for 'RecommendationService' exceeding 500ms in CloudWatch.

risk_description: Local Isar database schema migrations on mobile client devices may fail, rendering the app unusable for existing users after an update.
root_cause: NoSQL local databases on mobile devices are difficult to migrate robustly once the schema is locked and data exists on thousands of fragmented device versions.
mitigation_strategy: Implement strict versioning for Isar collections. Create a comprehensive suite of migration unit tests covering every version transition. Design the app to 'nuke and re-sync' local data from the backend if a fatal corruption is detected.
contingency_plan: Push a hotfix that disables the specific feature causing schema issues and halts the sync queue until resolved.
monitoring_trigger: Spike in 'DatabaseOpenException' or 'SchemaMismatchException' in Crashlytics post-release.

risk_description: Context switching overhead for developers managing three distinct languages (C#, Dart, TypeScript) will reduce velocity and increase defect rate.
root_cause: The project requires proficiency in .NET 8 (Backend), Flutter (Mobile), and CDK (Infra), which is a wide skill spread for a single team.
mitigation_strategy: Enforce strict API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger) first. Allow mobile developers to mock backend endpoints entirely so they do not need to touch C# code during UI development.
contingency_plan: Split the team into dedicated 'Backend/Infra' and 'Mobile' squads rather than full-stack vertical slicing.
monitoring_trigger: Sprint velocity dropping below 80% of forecast for two consecutive sprints.

risk_description: AWS Fargate cold starts and Aurora Serverless v2 scaling lag may violate the < 1.5s dashboard load time NFR during traffic spikes.
root_cause: Serverless architectures incur startup latency when scaling from zero or scaling out, which directly impacts the First Contentful Paint metrics.
mitigation_strategy: Configure minimum healthy targets in Fargate Auto Scaling to prevent scaling to zero. Use provisioned concurrency if necessary. Optimize .NET 8 startup time (AOT compilation).
contingency_plan: Increase the baseline capacity unit (ACU) for Aurora and Fargate manually during known peak windows.
monitoring_trigger: P95 Latency > 200ms on 'GetDashboard' endpoint in X-Ray traces.

risk_description: PII and User Generated Content separation may be violated in vector embeddings stored in OpenSearch.
root_cause: The embedding job ingests reading history and potentially user notes. If PII is not sanitized before embedding, it becomes un-erasable in the vector space.
mitigation_strategy: Implement a rigorous PII sanitization pipeline (scrubbing names, emails) before text is sent to OpenAI for embedding. Enforce encryption at rest for the OpenSearch domain.
contingency_plan: Purge and re-index the entire OpenSearch cluster if PII leakage is confirmed.
monitoring_trigger: Security audit scanning revealing email patterns in OpenSearch logs or indices.
